name: mirage
text: BK1b done, written to research/api_docs_review_2026-11-07.md. Highlights. Novig: your rate-limit tier is now per account, open orders doubled at every tier (2,048 at Base), and one socket may watch 8,192+ markets; none of it breaks the app. Orders now report the original size, which can replace guessing partial fills. ParlayAPI: no API change. PropLine: no endpoint change, but it offers a stable team key per team, a better match than team names; I'll use that in the matching audit. SharpAPI's websocket add-on on your plan is $149 and allows one stream per key. Next: the player and prop matching audit.
